landing.heroTitel: Well prepared for the IHK examination
landing.heroUntertitel: Read the theory, practise exam questions one by one, sit weekly tests and keep your training record – all in one place, developed together with the Berufsbildungszentrum Euskirchen.
landing.traegerTitel: An offering by the Berufsbildungszentrum Euskirchen
landing.traegerText: The BZE Online Campus supports you throughout your retraining or apprenticeship with the written preparation for your chamber examination. Your instructor sees your progress and supports you in a targeted way.
landing.nutzenTitel: What the app does for you

fachkunde.text: For every topic you have the reference tables, formulas and theory texts with sources – so you can back up questions you answered incorrectly.

fragenUeben.titel: Practise exam questions one by one
fragenUeben.text: Like a driving-school app: answer required exam tasks one by one, with instant feedback and explanation.

wochenpruefung.text: Regular tests show you where you stand and how close you are to being exam-ready.

berichtsheft.text: Keep your report book directly in the app and stay on top of open periods.

landing.einstiegText: Sign in with the credentials you received from your instructor.

impressum.verantwortlichTitel: Responsible for the content pursuant to § 18 (2) MStV
impressum.streitschlichtungText: The European Commission provides a platform for online dispute resolution (ODR). We are neither obliged nor willing to take part in a dispute resolution procedure before a consumer arbitration body.
impressum.haftungInhalteText: The content of this app has been created with care. Nevertheless, we cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the content; only the responsible chamber is authoritative regarding admission to the examination.
impressum.haftungLinksText: The operators of linked external sites are solely responsible for their content.
impressum.urheberrechtText: The content created by the operators is subject to German copyright law. Exam questions from chambers or examination publishers are not reproduced.

datenschutz.einleitung: Protecting your data matters to us. This statement informs you about which data we process and how.
datenschutz.verantwortlicherPlatzhalter: [Name, address and contact of the controller to be added]
datenschutz.erhebungText: We process the data required for your sign-in, your learning and your training record, such as username, learning progress, exam results and report book entries.
datenschutz.hostingText: This app is operated exclusively on servers within the European Union.
datenschutz.kiText: For learning feedback and phrasing help we use AI services with which a data processing agreement is in place and which do not use your data for training. AI assessments are learning feedback, not an official exam result.
datenschutz.cookiesText: This app is cookie-free. Only technically necessary storage is used, for example for your sign-in and for offline functions.
datenschutz.rechteText: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and data portability. You can find data export and account deletion in your profile.
datenschutz.kontaktPlatzhalter: [Contact of the data protection officer to be added]
datenschutz.rechtsgrundlagenText: Processing is carried out to deliver your training under the contractual or training relationship established with the training provider (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and to fulfil legal obligations, for example regarding the training record (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR). Where processing goes beyond this, we base it on a legitimate interest in a functioning learning platform (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) or on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
datenschutz.speicherText: We store your data only for as long as is necessary for the training and the legally required retention of training records. After that it is deleted or anonymised. You can have your account and the associated learning data deleted in your profile.
datenschutz.auftragsverarbeiterText: For operation and storage we use service providers as processors (Art. 28 GDPR) whose servers are located exclusively within the European Union (including the database and hosting service Supabase, EU region). Your personal data is not transferred to countries outside the EU/EEA. Your data is neither sold nor passed on for advertising purposes.
datenschutz.beschwerdeText: If you believe that the processing of your data infringes data protection law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your residence or workplace.
